items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: I don't know about father. [Context: Interviewer asks if Moran is Lizzie Miles' brother; Interviewee clarifies Moran is 'a brother by mother' to him, implying Lizzie Miles is his half-sister, but no direct interaction with Lizzie is described]

ctx.x: First off, that's going to be a big picture of a Navy band.
And I want to show you some of the... And, uh, Moran, you know Moran, Legend of Miles' brother. I got a picture of somewhere of the band and everything, but I can't find it.
